Phase 14 CI hardening and the two defects only CI could find (runs 39078543221 â†’ 39079850431 â†’ 39081533916). Run 39078543221 failed starting the storage services: pulling the Elasticsearch image exhausted the runner disk ('failed to register layer: write /usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/lib/server/classes_nocoops_nocoh.jsa: no space left on device'), and in the same run the storage conformance step still reported PASS because no backend was configured and every backend counted as skipped. Fixes: the workflow frees the runner's unused SDKs before building (disk-space.txt records 13 GB free before, 35 GB after), publishes the five services on non-default loopback ports, waits for PostgreSQL over TCP with credentials instead of pg_isready (which succeeds against the temporary server initdb runs before the real listener exists â€” the service logs show 'database system is ready to accept connections' twice for exactly that reason), and captures the service logs as evidence. ci/pytest_summary.py cross-checks the run's JUnit XML against the pytest console summary and FAILS the job when any test skipped; ci/storage_conformance.py --require-all fails when a backend is unconfigured. Run 39079850431 then executed all 665 test cases with 0 skipped (54 Docker integration + 5 storage service tests, the latter never run before) and failed on two genuine defects: PostgreSQL health always returned ok false because pg8000's protocol layer builds every row as a Python list (pg8000/core.py handle_DATA_ROW) so SELECT 1 yields [[1]] and the check compared it against [(1,)]; and MigrationRunner.run() read aletheia_schema_migrations before applying anything, while migration 1 was what created that table, so migrate failed with 'relation "aletheia_schema_migrations" does not exist' on a fresh database. A third failure was a test that asserted the developer machine's environment (every backend variable unset) and so failed in CI where they are all set. All three are fixed and pinned by tests that need no server (tests/test_storage.py covers the runner ordering, the pg8000 list-row shape, a configured-but-unreachable backend, and sync applying migrations first). Final state: 672 passed, 0 skipped, 6/6 backends conform.
